user.title: Innoxel Master 2
user.description: The Master 2 has no network port. Enter the address of the serial device server (e.g. Moxa NPort in TCP server mode) it is connected to.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the serial device server.
data_description.port: TCP port of the serial device server (Moxa default: 4001).

error.cannot_connect: No Master 2 answers at this address. Check the address, the port and whether another program (e.g. INNOXEL Setup) holds the connection.

user.title: Add switch
user.description: A switch is an output that a key toggles. The key must be programmed in INNOXEL Setup to toggle this output.

data_description.key: Input address such as I10-1, or the event from INNOXEL Setup such as GR28.
data_description.output: Output address such as O0-3. Leave empty to detect it: the key is then pressed twice and the integration watches which output changes.

user.title: Add blind
user.description: A blind with one key for up and one for down. A short key press runs the blind to its end position, a press while it moves stops it.

data_description.key_up: Input address such as I12-1, or the event from INNOXEL Setup such as GR30.
data_description.key_down: Input address such as I12-2, or the event from INNOXEL Setup such as GR31.
data_description.output_up: Optional. Motor output for up such as O4-0; shows in Home Assistant when the blind opens.
data_description.output_down: Optional. Motor output for down such as O4-1; shows in Home Assistant when the blind closes.
